name: Manufacturing
author: Brandon
description:
Made with the Sandustry Material Studio.

THE NAME SWAP
The world's old sand is SOIL now (renamed in place - an existing save converts instantly). Soil still wets into Wet Soil and Wet Soil still refines on the Shaker into gold and residue, exactly as before.

SAND, REBORN
The desert owns the name now. Broken dunes drop SAND - a golden grain that looks like the sunsand it replaces - and unlike sunsand it rides belts and vacuums like any honest solid. Research MANUFACTURING (left of the Smelter in the tech tree, 250 gold) and then GLASS (500 gold) and the Smelter learns to convert Sand 1:1 into GLASS, slightly lighter so it clears the machine. Until then Sand just sits on it.

NO MORE SUNSAND
Sunsand is gone: any grain of it that so much as twitches converts into Sand. Resting grains still harden into dunes as ever - which then break into Sand. One consequence to mine around: with sunsand gone the desert no longer regrows. What you dig is dug.

MOD TOOLS
One free research node behind the Shaker unlocks the whole testing kit: the Matter Gun (fires any material, picker at the bottom of the screen), delete buttons on every vacuum tank, and the Omni Vacuum - sucks anything, liquids and gases included, with 10x tank storage.

FASTER MK.2 FILTERS
Once MANUFACTURING is researched, the Upgrades pane gets a Manufacturing tab with one upgrade on the Mk.2 Filter (500): Belt-Speed Filtering. Buy it once and it becomes an On/Off switch; ON makes every Mk.2 Filter move material as fast as a Mk.2 Conveyor Belt. Sorting is unchanged.

RED-BLOCK FIX
Stuck undiggable red blocks (orphaned Block terrain left by removed structures)? Flip 'Clear stuck red blocks' ON in these settings to sweep them off the whole map.

enabled.descriptionKey: Turn the mod off without unsubscribing. Recipes can only be withdrawn at load, so switching off leaves them until the next restart.

clearRedBlocks.labelKey: Clear stuck red blocks (turn ON to run once)
clearRedBlocks.descriptionKey: Sweeps the whole map and removes stuck red terrain left behind by removed structures (the undiggable red blocks with nothing to deconstruct) - both the default Block stamp and the mod-structure stamp. Only cells with NO structure on them are cleared, so real foundations are safe. Takes ~30s with progress toasts. To run it again later, switch this OFF and back ON.

showProbe.descriptionKey: Shows a small readout of what is at your cell and in a 5x5 around your feet: structure type, element, terrain and raw cell id. Handy for identifying mystery blocks. Off by default.
